summary: Close F-010 by moving catalog and runtime module state construction routing out of main.js into one canonical design-state construction registry, with full-system impact review under the current gate.

impactAnalysis.notes: Retroactive full-system revalidation after the F-010 branch was rebased onto the current ROG gate. The canonical constructor changes state-construction ownership across catalog, automatic wall/depot and illuminated-foam paths. F-028 is explicitly affected because its reset failure depends on the old non-catalog construction gap; it is not closed by this PR without its own acceptance/closure evidence. F-013/F-018/F-019 were reviewed because they share identity/state-factory surfaces but their independent root gaps are not remediated here.

e2e.reason: F-010 changes browser-visible stage/module construction routes. The canonical smoke flow creates a real stand through the UI and exercises automatic wall state construction under Chromium; registry/unit coverage separately exercises every catalog descriptor and illuminated-foam.

risk.notes: Module creation routing changes ownership but is intended to preserve existing factory semantics, catalog identity attachment, placement preservation, automatic-wall/depot construction and illuminated-foam behavior.

migration.notes: No persisted project schema changes; existing module state shapes remain unchanged.

rollback: Revert the F-010 remediation commit to restore main.js-owned construction dispatch.
